title: Regex Dialect Transpiler & Compatibility Matrix Specification
description: Formal specification for analyzing, validating, and transpiling regular expressions across PCRE, Go RE2, JavaScript (ECMAScript), Python re, and Rust regex engines with ReDoS and linear time diagnostics.

go_re2.name: Go RE2
go_re2.time_complexity: Guaranteed O(N) Linear time (DFA/NFA, Zero ReDoS)

ERR_UNSUPPORTED_LOOKAROUND.title: Lookaround Assertions Forbidden
ERR_UNSUPPORTED_LOOKAROUND.description: Lookahead (?=...), (?!...) and Lookbehind (?<=...), (?<!...) are not supported in RE2 / Rust linear engines to guarantee O(N) time and prevent ReDoS attacks.

ERR_UNSUPPORTED_BACKREFERENCE.title: Backreferences Forbidden
ERR_UNSUPPORTED_BACKREFERENCE.description: Backreferences (\1, \k<name>) require non-deterministic backtracking and are forbidden in DFA/RE2 engines.

ERR_UNSUPPORTED_RECURSION.title: Pattern Recursion Unsupported
ERR_UNSUPPORTED_RECURSION.description: Recursive subroutine calls (?R), (?1) are exclusive to PCRE and cannot be compiled in RE2, JS, or standard Python.

WARN_ATOMIC_GROUP_CONVERTED.title: Atomic Group Converted to Non-Capturing
WARN_ATOMIC_GROUP_CONVERTED.description: Atomic group (?>...) was converted to non-capturing group (?:...) because RE2 does not backtrack.

WARN_POSSESSIVE_QUANTIFIER_CONVERTED.title: Possessive Quantifier Simplified
WARN_POSSESSIVE_QUANTIFIER_CONVERTED.description: Possessive quantifier (++ or *+) was simplified to greedy quantifier (+ or *) in RE2.

WARN_NAMED_GROUP_SYNTAX_TRANSPILLED.title: Named Group Syntax Transpiled
WARN_NAMED_GROUP_SYNTAX_TRANSPILLED.description: Named capture group syntax was adjusted to match the target engine convention.

INFO_LINEAR_TIME_GUARANTEED.title: Linear Execution Guaranteed
INFO_LINEAR_TIME_GUARANTEED.description: Target engine operates with guaranteed linear O(N) execution time with zero ReDoS risk.

presets.name: Password Complexity (Lookaheads)
presets.description: Password strength pattern requiring uppercase, lowercase, and digit using PCRE lookaheads.

presets.name: HTTP Log Parser (Named Groups)
presets.description: Access log regex with named capture groups to be transpiled for Go RE2 / Python.

presets.name: Fast Quoted String (Possessive)
presets.description: Quoted string matcher using possessive quantifier to avoid catastrophic backtracking in PCRE.

presets.name: Case-Insensitive Identifier
presets.description: Slug and identifier matcher with inline case-insensitivity flag.
